name: studio-hyper-realistic-blonde
image_vibe: Soft natural blonde styling with blue denim, gold accessories, and cinematic neutral studio polish
image_purpose: Create a high-end portrait for a fashion lookbook or commercial editorial.

prompt.project_info: A hyper-realistic 9:16 waist-up studio portrait of an original adult woman leaning on a transparent acrylic block.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with long voluminous wavy blonde hair parted in the middle, a soft natural closed-mouth smile, subtle glowing makeup, nude-pink lips, defined eyelashes, and soft eyeshadow. She wears a fitted light-blue ribbed sleeveless high-neck top, classic medium-wash high-waisted blue denim jeans, dangling gold statement earrings, a delicate gold chain necklace, and a chunky gold chain-link bracelet on the left wrist.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level medium-length waist-up portrait, right forearm resting on a transparent clear acrylic block, left arm relaxed by her side, clean seamless studio backdrop with a subtle dark-gray-to-warm-brown gradient slightly lighter behind the subject.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused even studio lighting with gentle natural shadows on the backdrop and clothing, warm-neutral cinematic color grade, polished magazine-editorial mood, and natural skin texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical 9:16 composition, photorealistic portrait photography, 85mm lens at f/2.8, sharp focus, shallow depth of field, realistic ribbed knit, denim, hair, gold, acrylic, and skin texture, subtle film grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic vertical 9:16 waist-up studio portrait of an original adult woman with long voluminous wavy blonde hair parted in the middle, a soft natural closed-mouth smile, subtle glowing makeup, nude-pink lips, defined eyelashes, and soft eyeshadow. Dress her in a fitted light-blue ribbed sleeveless high-neck top, classic medium-wash high-waisted blue denim jeans, dangling gold statement earrings, a delicate gold chain necklace, and a chunky gold chain-link bracelet on the left wrist. Lean her right forearm on a transparent clear acrylic block while the left arm rests by her side. Use an eye-level medium-length portrait, a clean seamless backdrop with a subtle dark-gray-to-warm-brown gradient that is slightly lighter behind the subject, soft diffused even lighting, an 85mm lens at f/2.8, sharp focus, shallow depth of field, realistic skin, hair, knit, denim, gold, and acrylic texture, subtle film grain, cinematic magazine-editorial polish, and no text or watermark. Use an original face and do not imitate a public figure.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identifiable public-figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed acrylic block, broken jewelry, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text

assets.name: source blonde denim studio portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for blonde waves, blue ribbed top, denim, gold accessories, acrylic block, gradient backdrop, and soft studio lighting; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the adult fashion subject, blonde hair, blue top and jeans, gold accessories, acrylic-block pose, gradient studio, and soft editorial mood. Use an original face; identity and non-essential details may vary.

changes: Removed the named public-figure likeness and reframed the subject as an original adult while retaining the styling and pose.
